thread:
oliver: Heads-up: after the overnight runtime roll to v4.0.0 we got a small but consistent divergence in Llama4Q output tokenization for short prompts. Noticed in nightly smoke for model=llama4q.

mei: How big is "small"? Is this semantic or just whitespace/tokenization differences?

oliver: Mostly tokenization and subtle detokenization spacing. BLEU/ROUGE are fine but our structured-output tests that parse JSON blobs are failing ~5% of cases. Affects quantized paths only.

release-manager: Is this tied to the runtime kernel change or SDK serialization updates?

oliver: Early signal points to the runtime's new tokenizer cache hash change in v4.0.0; SDK stayed the same. Can reproduce by toggling the tokenizer_cache flag.

mei: Mitigation suggestion: scoped runtime pin back to v3.9.7 for model-tag=llama4q on staging and dedicated-test fleets for 8h while we push a tokenizer-cache fix. Keep prod live.

deploy-bot: Suggested command: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.9.7 --scope=model-tag:llama4q --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=8h --reason="tokenization mismatch after runtime v4.0.0"`. No conflicting pins detected.

oliver: Agree. QA run will verify parseable JSON outputs at +15m and +60m.

qa-bot: Starting regression: structured-output parse test on llama4q. ETA 15m. Will post pass/fail.

release-manager: I'll add a short note to the release log about the scoped pin and link this thread. If the pin needs extension past 8h, include diffs and customer impact.

mei: Applying pin now. `/deploy pin runtime:v3.9.7 --scope=model-tag:llama4q --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=8h --reason="tokenization mismatch after runtime v4.0.0"`
deploy-bot: Pin created ✅

oliver: Thanks — monitoring the QA results. We'll post update when tokenizer patch PR is ready.
